args.query:
-- Calculate mean for cognitive_score using subquery
SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as mean_score,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM measurements;

-- Calculate mean and std for cognitive_score (population std dev)
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as mean_score
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    AVG(cognitive_score) as mean_score,
    SQRT(AVG((cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - (2 * cognitive_score * mean_score) + (mean_score * mean_score))) as std_dev
FROM measurements, stats;

-- Check unique conditions and statuses
SELECT DISTINCT condition FROM measurements ORDER BY condition;

-- Check reaction time distribution
SELECT 
    AVG(reaction_ms) as mean_reaction,
    SQRT(AVG((reaction_ms - (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) * 
             (reaction_ms - (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)))) as reaction_std_dev,
    MIN(reaction_ms),
    MAX(reaction_ms)
FROM measurements;

-- Check which cognitive_scores are outliers (> 2 SD from mean: 74.04 ± 50.39 = [23.65, 124.43])
-- Values less than ~23.65 are outliers
SELECT participant_id, cognitive_score, reaction_ms
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score < 23.65;

-- Check which reaction_ms values are outliers (> 2 SD from mean: 413.60 ± 566.80 = [-153.20, 980.40])
-- Values greater than ~980 ms are outliers
SELECT participant_id, reaction_ms, cognitive_score
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms > 980;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score >= 23.65
AND reaction_ms <= 980.40;
SELECT COUNT(*) as cleaned_count FROM cleaned_measurements;

-- Verify the cleaned table was created correctly
PRAGMA table_info(cleaned_measurements);

-- Show a sample from the cleaned table
SELECT participant_id, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, condition
FROM cleaned_measurements
ORDER BY participant_id, recorded_at
LIMIT 10;

-- Verify no outliers remain in cleaned table (cognitive_score >= 23.65 AND reaction_ms <= 980.40)
SELECT 
    'cognitive_score' as metric,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as mean,
    AVG(cognitive_score - 23.65) as min_from_threshold,
    MAX(cognitive_score) as max
FROM cleaned_measurements
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'reaction_ms' as metric,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as mean,
    AVG(reaction_ms - 980.40) as min_from_threshold,
    MAX(reaction_ms) as max
FROM cleaned_measurements;

-- Final verification summary
SELECT 
    'ORIGINAL' as source,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cognitive,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction
FROM measurements
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'CLEANED' as source,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cognitive,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction
FROM cleaned_measurements
ORDER BY source;
